response.sql: SELECT AVG(rebrate / feerate) AS avg_rebate_to_fee_ratio, COUNT(*) AS fee_record_count FROM fees WHERE feerate > 0.0009;

assumptions.assumption: The high fee-rate band means feerate > 0.0009.
The record count includes all fees in that band; AVG ignores records with a missing rebrate.

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff is included in the high fee-rate band.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(rebrate / feerate) AS avg_rebate_to_fee_ratio, COUNT(*) AS fee_record_count FROM fees WHERE feerate >= 0.0009;

alternatives.interpretation: The count includes only records with a rebate rate available for the ratio.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(rebrate / feerate) AS avg_rebate_to_fee_ratio, COUNT(*) AS fee_record_count FROM fees WHERE feerate > 0.0009 AND rebrate IS NOT NULL;
